verdict.rationale: Community Phone is a phone service, so number provisioning is a fair question. However, the evidence covers only porting existing numbers (a rep-managed process taking about 3-5 business days), hardware setup taking minutes, and adding lines or a virtual line. Nothing documents searching available numbers by area code or buying a new local number self-serve in minutes.

support.subject: As a founder, I can search available numbers by area code and buy a local number in minutes
